description: Figure 3 is a pie chart illustrating the distribution of different input stimulus material types provided by journalists to large language models (LLMs) during WildChat conversations, where these conversations were matched to online articles from two identified news agencies. The chart is divided into six distinct slices, each representing a different type of input material. The largest slice, colored dark green, accounts for approximately 50% of the total. The second largest slice, colored light green, represents about 25%. A third slice, colored orange, makes up roughly 15%. Two smaller slices, one light blue and one dark blue, each represent about 5%. The smallest slice, colored gray, accounts for approximately 2%. The chart includes a legend identifying the categories by color, but no percentage labels are shown within the slices. The chart does not appear to have any exploded or emphasized segments.
